hunks.baseline: “What’s wrong with you people? Why are you all making such a fuss as if you can’t bear to die first?”
hunks.sol: “What the hell is wrong with you people? Why are you both so desperate to die first?”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung opened his mouth as his consciousness began to fade. His voice came out heavily suppressed.
hunks.sol: As his consciousness faded, Cheongpung opened his mouth. A strained voice escaped him.

hunks.baseline: “Because… I think I’d regret it for the rest of my life if I backed down.”
hunks.sol: “Because… I thought I’d regret it for the rest of my life if I backed down.”

hunks.baseline: His killing intent grew even more savage.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord’s killing intent grew even more savage.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, Cheongpung was not afraid at all.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung was not frightened at all.

hunks.baseline: As though he had returned to the days he spent on Lotus Peak, he unconsciously lifted the corners of his mouth.
hunks.sol: It felt as though he had returned to his days on Lotus Peak. Before he knew it, the corners of his mouth had lifted.

hunks.baseline: He had smiled while standing before him.
hunks.sol: He had dared to smile in front of him.
It was impossible.

hunks.baseline: It was impossible. It was something that should never have happened.
hunks.sol: It was something that should never have happened.

hunks.baseline: He was about to drive the spearhead into Cheongpung’s chest when—
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord was about to drive the spearhead into Cheongpung’s chest when—

hunks.baseline: It was a voice he felt he finally recognized.
hunks.sol: A voice he felt he finally recognized.
